name: Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers 2026 – Davao
short_description: A half-marathon and multi-distance race organized by Franklin Baker, taking place September 20, 2026, in Davao City, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers 2026 is a half-marathon event set for September 20, 2026, in Davao City, Philippines. Organized by Franklin Baker, the race will be held at the Franklin Baker Daron Plant and offers four distance options: 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
